cases.title: Add Note Creation and Multiple Rapid Clicks
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Add note button creates and appends a new note <div> element with class 'note' containing a visible, empty textarea (data-testid='note-textarea'). Verify that multiple rapid clicks successfully create separate, independent notes each with their own textarea.

cases.title: Markdown Rendering and Persistence
cases.description: Verify that typing Markdown into the note textarea dynamically renders formatted HTML in real-time in the main display area (data-testid='note-main'). Verify that invalid Markdown does not crash the app, shows raw input upon exiting edit mode, and all changes persist immediately to local storage.

cases.title: Initial Edit Mode and View/Edit Mode Toggling
cases.description: Verify that newly created notes immediately enter edit mode with the textarea visible and main content area hidden. Verify that clicking the Edit button (data-testid='edit-note-button') toggles between edit and view modes correctly, auto-saving changes to local storage.

cases.title: Note Deletion from DOM and LocalStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Delete button (data-testid='delete-note-button') on a note immediately removes the targeted note from the DOM and deletes the corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Load Saved Notes from LocalStorage on Page Initialization
cases.description: Verify that upon page load, saved notes are retrieved from localStorage and rendered with tools, edit and delete buttons, main content area, and textarea. Verify notes with content show main div and hide textarea by default, empty content notes show textarea and hide main div, and empty localStorage displays no notes.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behavior includes clicking the 'Add note' button (id=add, class=add, data-testid=add-note-button), verifying a new <div> with class 'note' is appended to document body, containing a visible and empty <textarea> (data-testid=note-textarea). Boundaries involve multiple rapid clicks generating separate, independent notes and textareas. Normal path is single click creating one note; abnormal path includes spamming clicks. R-2: Testable behavior involves editing notes with Markdown rendering. Users type into <textarea> (data-testid=note-textarea), content dynamically renders in <div data-testid=note-main> in real-time with HTML formatting. Complex/invalid Markdown (e.g., unmatched **) should not crash and displays raw input upon exiting edit mode via 'Edit' button (data-testid=edit-note-button). Changes persist immediately to local storage. Normal path: valid Markdown rendering; abnormal path: invalid Markdown handling. R-3: Testable behavior includes app load creation and mode toggling. Page load allows 'Add note' creation; upon creation, note enters edit mode (textarea visible, main content hidden). Users switch modes via 'Edit' button (data-testid=edit-note-button): view mode shows formatted content and hides textarea, edit mode does reverse. Changes auto-save to local storage across sessions. R-4: Testable behavior is deleting a note via 'Delete' button (data-testid=delete-note-button). Upon click, note is immediately removed from the DOM and corresponding entry removed from localStorage. Normal path: clicking delete removes target note only; boundaries: deleting the last remaining note. R-5: Testable behavior includes loading saved notes from localStorage on page load. App creates <div> with class 'note', 'tools' containing 'Edit' (data-testid=edit-note-button) and 'Delete' (data-testid=delete-note-button) buttons, 'main' (data-testid="note-main"), and 'textarea' (data-testid=note-textarea). Notes with content show main div and hide textarea by default; notes with no content show textarea and hide main div. Empty localStorage displays no notes. Ambiguity: exact key name for localStorage is 'notes' parsed via JSON.parse.
